plan.description: Planning agent. Uses Anthropic Opus 4.7 with xhigh reasoning for complex reasoning, architecture decisions, and multi-step planning. Read-only — no file edits.

tester.description: Test writer + runner. Uses Nemotron 3 Ultra Free for reading code, writing Vitest/Playwright tests, running them, and reporting pass/fail with evidence. Sits between planner (read-only) and builder (write code). Writes test files only — no production code edits.

build.description: Build agent. Uses MiMo 2.5 Free for code generation, edits, and implementation tasks. Full edit + bash access.
